name: plugin-scout
description: Scan the current project's manifests and suggest every cc-plugins-marketplace plugin in three tiers — stack-matched, the curated any-project core, and the universal remainder — then install the picked ones after confirmation; --yes auto-installs the first two tiers, --full installs everything relevant to the detected stack after one plan confirm (--stack a,b,c fills in a stack the manifests do not show yet), --all offers every row explicitly, --persist/--global choose scope. Includes /plugin-scout:suggest.
